name: browser_tabs
description: List, focus, or close this session's tabs. List gives fresh handles from the live browser; with no tab yet it needs none and names those connected.

action.description: list: List this session's tabs. focus, close:

tab.description: From browser_tabs list.

name: browser_navigate
description: Go to an HTTP(S) URL. Reuses the obvious tab; new_tab true opens a new one.

beforeunload.description: Discard an unsaved-changes prompt this navigation causes. Default stops and reports it.

browser.description: Only with new_tab true. From browser_tabs list. Omit to use the browser the user attended last.

reuse.description: domain reuses a tab an earlier session of this client released for this host, never one the person opened. never always creates. domain cannot combine with new_tab.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_history
description: Go back or forward, or reload. A new document invalidates target_ and view_ handles, so collect fresh ones.

action.description: back: Go back one page. forward: Go forward one page. reload: Reload the page.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_window
description: Set a tab's zoom or resize its browser window. Either invalidates view_ handles, so take a fresh screenshot before coordinate work.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_read
description: Read visible page text, including open shadow roots and frames, or one target. To act, get handles from browser_inspect or browser_find.

mode.description: article prefers the top document's article, else the full page. Ignored with target.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_inspect
description: Inspect controls or page structure for fresh target_ handles. Scope document returns the outline as a bounded tree, without handles. Form controls also carry their value and what they accept: options, type, limits, hint and group.

scope.description: document: a {kind, label, children} tree, a snapshot handle, and a diff against the previous snapshot when root and max_depth match.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_find
description: Find targets by visible or accessible text and get fresh target_ handles. Fastest when you know the label. Option text finds its dropdown.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_screenshot
description: Capture the viewport, full page, one target, or a magnified region; returns a view_ handle for coordinate calls.

full_page.description: True captures the whole document. Not with target or a region.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

view.description: The region is in this view's image pixels; take a screenshot first.

name: browser_click
description: Click a target_ handle, a control found by selector, or a point in a view_ screenshot. Needs action; a selector lookup or expect check also needs read. Prefer a target.

expect.description: Checked after the effect; needs read, admitted before the effect. A failed check keeps the effect.

value.description: Omit for load_ready, else required; page text, not field values.

name.description: Accessible name, case-insensitive substring unless exact.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

view.description: x and y are pixels in this view's screenshot image; take one first.

name: browser_scroll
description: Scroll the page (default down, medium), reveal a target_, or wheel-scroll at a point in a view_ screenshot.

direction.description: Wheel scrolling at a view point takes only up or down.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

view.description: x and y are pixels in this view's screenshot image; take one first.

name: browser_hover
description: Hover a target_ handle or a point in a view_ screenshot.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

view.description: x and y are pixels in this view's screenshot image; take one first.

name: browser_fill_form
description: Fill 1 to 30 fields in one call; needs write even for unsent drafts. Nothing submits unless submit_target names the control. A value a control cannot take is refused before any field changes, with what it accepts. For credentials, set user_authorized_credentials only on the user's explicit instruction.

expect.description: Checked after the effect; needs read, admitted before the effect. A failed check keeps the effect.

value.description: Omit for load_ready, else required; page text, not field values.

fields.description: Each field gives exactly one of target or selector.

name.description: Accessible name, case-insensitive substring unless exact.

value.description: Text replaces the current value; empty clears it. Select: an option's text or value as browser_inspect lists it; multi-select: an array. Checkbox: true or false (sets, never toggles). Radio: true selects it, or a sibling's label selects that one. Date and time: ISO, like 2026-10-14, 14:30, 2026-10-14T14:30. Number and range: within the control's limits.

submit_target.description: Clicked after filling; may cause an external effect.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

user_authorized_credentials.description: True only when the user explicitly authorized credential entry for this request. Never overrides policy or the person's Pause or End session.

name: browser_type_text
description: Type through real keyboard input. Needs action; a selector lookup or expect check also needs read. Prefer browser_fill_form for plain values. For credentials, set user_authorized_credentials only on the user's explicit instruction.

expect.description: Checked after the effect; needs read, admitted before the effect. A failed check keeps the effect.

value.description: Omit for load_ready, else required; page text, not field values.

focused.description: True types into the focused control instead of target.

name.description: Accessible name, case-insensitive substring unless exact.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

text.description: Empty text only clears, and needs clear_first true.

user_authorized_credentials.description: True only when the user explicitly authorized credential entry for this request. Never overrides policy or the person's Pause or End session.

name: browser_press_key
description: Send a named key or literal character, optionally at a target_. Needs action; an expect check also needs read. For Control+A send key a with modifiers Control; strokes sends keys in order.

expect.description: Checked after the effect; needs read, admitted before the effect. A failed check keeps the effect.

value.description: Omit for load_ready, else required; page text, not field values.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_drag
description: Drag between two target_ handles or two points in one view_ screenshot.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

view.description: Both points are pixels in this view's screenshot image; take one first.

name: browser_wait
description: Wait for one observable page condition. A false condition is a failed result, not an unknown effect.

condition.description: load_ready: Page finished loading. url_contains: URL contains value. text_present: value is in the visible text. text_absent: value is gone from the visible text. target_present: target exists. target_absent: target is gone. visual_settle: The page, or target, stopped moving and repainting. selector_present: selector matches a control. duration: Waits value milliseconds.

name.description: Accessible name, case-insensitive substring unless exact.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

value.description: Text or URL fragment; page text, not field values. For duration, milliseconds from 0 to 10000 as a string.

visual_settle.description: Also settle the layout once the condition holds. Off by default for url_contains, text_present, text_absent, and target_absent; on for the rest.

name: browser_dialog
description: Read the open JavaScript dialog with status, then accept, dismiss, or answer it; it blocks its page.

action.description: status: Its kind and message, if open. accept: As OK does. dismiss: Dismiss it. respond: Answer a prompt.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_upload
description: Attach local paths, inline files, or one captured image to a file input, or drop the image at a point in a view_. Needs write; a selector lookup also needs read.

name.description: Accessible name, case-insensitive substring unless exact.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

view.description: x and y are pixels in this view's image; needs source_image.

name: browser_execute
description: Run JavaScript in the page main world. It may read, mutate, or navigate; prefer a semantic tool. A script that is one expression is awaited, so a promise it evaluates to resolves.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_flow
description: Run 1 to 20 tool calls. tab defaults tab-scoped steps; a step's own tab wins. Later arguments may reference earlier results. Stops at the first failed step by default.

arguments.description: That tool's arguments. Any value may be a reference object: {"flow_ref":{"step":"earlier_id","pointer":"/facts/..."}}.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: browser_record
description: Record browser work as a short memory-only GIF. One recording per session; save stops an active capture.

action.description: start: Start recording. status: Report state and bounds. stop: Stop and keep the frames in memory. save: Save the GIF. Needs read for captured sources, plus write when attaching to a target; an active capture stops after admission. discard: Erase captured bytes. This cannot be undone.

download.description: The browser saves the replay as a file and chooses where.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

target.description: File input to attach the replay to, inside the browser.

name: browser_diagnose
description: Read opt-in console and network observations for a tab. Observation begins with the first call, so reload or reproduce to capture earlier activity. Sensitive request data is never collected.

detail.description: problems: warnings, errors, failed requests, and HTTP failures.

match.description: Case-insensitive literal filter, not a regular expression.

tab.description: Omit when one tab is unambiguous.

name: policy_explain
description: Explain the authority in force: one line per capability with its deciding layer, the rules behind them, permanent ceilings, and each layer's document. Available under every authority; use it to learn why a call was refused or what is allowed.
